text:
8.1 (a) Find a complete sufficient statistic
\[
\frac{\theta 2^\theta}{x^{\theta+1}}
\mathbf{1}_{[2,+\infty)}(x)
\]
Solution:
\[
S = \sum_i \ln X_i
\quad
\text{is complete and sufficient by the property of a full-rank exponential family.}
\]

8.4 (d) obtain asymptotic interval for \(x_m\)
\[
\begin{array}{ll}
\text{ (1) asymptotic var prop }:& \hat{\theta} \text{ is MLE } \implies 2^{1 + \frac{1}{\hat{\theta}}} \text{ is MLE } for 2^{1 + \frac{1}{\theta}}\\[0.5em]
\text{ (2) By CLT + asymptotic prop of MLE:}& \hat{\theta} \sim \mathcal{N}(\theta, \frac{1}{I_{\underline{X}}(\theta)})\\[0.5em]
\text{ (3) By Delta method, } \tilde{\theta} = g(\hat{\theta}) \sim \mathcal{N}(g(\theta), \frac{(g'(\theta))^2}{I_{\underline{X}}(\theta)}) \text{ where } (g'(\theta ))^2 = (2^{1 + \frac{1}{\theta}} \ln 2 (-1) \frac{1}{\theta^2})^2 = 2^{2(1 + \frac{1}{\theta})} (\ln 2)^2 \frac{1}{\theta^4}\\[0.5em]
\text{ (4) now obtain Fischer for the sample}&
I_{\underline{X}}(\theta) = - \mathbb{E}(\frac{\partial^2 \ell }{\partial {\theta}^2}) = \frac{n}{\theta^2}\\[0.5em]
\text{ (5) now calculate the asympt variance}& \mathrm{Avar}(\tilde{\theta}) = 2^{2(1 + \frac{1}{\theta})} (\ln 2)^2 \frac{1}{n \theta^2} \implies x_m \in \tilde{\theta} \pm z_\alpha \frac{2^{1 + \frac{1}{\theta}} (\ln 2)^2}{\theta \sqrt{n}}
\end{array}
\]
